$comment: Index of reusable product patterns Chief Wiggum can stamp into the apps it builds. See docs/patterns-registry.md. Each entry points at patterns/<id>/{pattern.md,manifest.json}. Candidates are mined/known but not yet fully specified.
$model: A pattern IS a cluster of invariants that must hold together, plus the playbook to satisfy them. See docs/patterns-registry.md#patterns-as-clusters-of-invariants. Each pattern/candidate carries an `invariants` array of generic stable ids (INV-<ABBR>-NNN) with `realized_as` provenance (the mined app's app-specific id + code). /architect pulls the cluster into invariants.md by id so connected requirements are never re-derived; the traceability/single-writer/ratchet gates then hold the whole cluster.

patterns.title: Improvement Lifecycle Loop
patterns.summary: Autonomous, signal-driven, ratchet-gated fix-forward refinement installed into the product. Trusted-signal changes deploy autonomously; untrusted-signal (end-user) changes quarantine for blocking admin approval.

patterns.title: Engagement Instrumentation
patterns.summary: Server-trusted, tamper-resistant capture of how far users get through assigned work/content, robust to out-of-order/replay/concurrent/clock-drift. The instrumentation tier that feeds the improvement loop; each signal annotated with its trust class.

patterns.title: Tiered Subscription
patterns.summary: Subscribe -> enforce -> lifecycle machinery for a plan-tiered SaaS: single-source tier matrix, injected gate seams, stateless quota, billing-webhook as source of truth, and non-destructive graceful degradation on downgrade/lapse. Absorbs the former tiered-saas-enforcement candidate.

patterns.title: Frictionless Onboarding (free -> upgrade)
patterns.summary: Minimize time-to-value on a free tier, convert at contextual friction points (limit-hit prompts, optional reverse trial), self-serve. The mini-SaaS pattern most improved by the loop -- and, since its proposals touch pricing/paywall driven by end-user behavior, always admin-gated.

patterns.title: Deployment & Release
patterns.summary: build -> stage -> promote machinery that gets a change to prod safely and provably: keyless federated CI identity, environment split with a human-gated prod promotion, promotion of the byte-identical staged artifact, a config-leak fence, a least-privilege deploy identity that can roll releases but not mutate infra/read secrets, and post-deploy smoke verification. Mined from two shipped GCP apps.

patterns.title: Fetch-on-Webhook Reconcile (non-monotonic external state)
patterns.summary: Correct idempotency for a webhook whose external resource is NON-monotonic (subscriptions, refunds): event = trigger only, live fetch = truth, never copy mutable state off the payload. Order-immune, unknown-id-fatal (never silent-floor), retry-lease dedupe, terminal-deletion latch. Ships its sibling MONOTONIC-FSM branch (video-upload style) so the selection criterion travels with it. Expressed as an invariant cluster (INV-FOWR-*).

patterns.title: Revocable Elevated-Access Session (support impersonation)
patterns.summary: Time-boxed, revocable, dual-identity-audited operator act-as. Session TTL enforced against the session's own iat (independent of the IdP token life), future-skew guard, fail-closed revocation, no nested impersonation, boundary-checked deny-list (operator plane + auth-factor + destructive/GDPR), dual-identity audit before every impersonated mutation, un-forgeable at the signing root. Promoted from candidate; realized 1:1 in a shipped production SaaS (private) as INV-EAS-001..007.

patterns.title: Multi-Tenant Isolation Stack
patterns.summary: The isolation floor: server-only tenant resolution (reject client hints, anti-probe 404) -> fail-closed tenant-scoped repository (no unscoped path, reject-don't-override recursively incl. $rename string values, unexported handles) -> standing cross-tenant proof gate (denial AND no-mutation AND no-foreign-id-leak) -> cancel-latched resumable transactional cascade erasure with a tax-tombstone exception. The operator plane sits OUTSIDE tenancy. Promoted from candidate; INV-MTI-001..006.

patterns.title: Provider-Neutral Port/Adapter
patterns.summary: The swappability seam for an external vendor: single-file vendor confinement (SDK imported in exactly one file, import-lint enforceable), neutral DTOs only + unexported concrete adapter with a compile-time var _ Port assertion (+ Fake), vendor-state->enum with safe defaults, signed-webhook-normalized-to-neutral-event (webhook is truth, not the client redirect), sign-per-request TTL-clamped tokens, and direct browser->CDN upload via a one-time ticket (API credential never reaches the browser). Promoted from candidate; realized twice in a shipped production SaaS (private; video + billing seams). INV-PNA-001..006.

patterns.title: Floor-Raising Entitlement Overlay (admin comps)
patterns.summary: Grant an account MORE than its plan pays for (comps, bespoke limits) without touching billing: a local overlay orthogonal to the payer tier, effective = per-field max(payer, overlay), grant-only, and the reconcile recomputes the max so a webhook can never revert a comp. Load-bearing guard: the -1 unlimited sentinel must beat any finite value in BOTH directions or a naive max silently lowers an unlimited plan. In-house override chosen over billing-vendor coupons so bespoke custom limits stay expressible. Promoted from candidate; INV-EO-001..005.

patterns.title: Immutable Assignment Snapshot
patterns.summary: Edit a template without retroactively changing work already assigned from it: publishing snapshots the template into a write-once Version (insert+find only), editing forks a NEW version, and assignments pin a version id by reference (must-not-drift item fields value-copied at publish). Keeps outstanding assignments as-assigned and longitudinal completion drift-free. Nuance mined from code: immutability lives in the write-once version snapshot at publish, not a copy-into-the-assignment. Promoted from candidate; INV-IAS-001..003.

patterns.title: Referral / Invite Growth Loop
patterns.summary: Invite -> signed, single-use, expiring token -> server-trusted attribution on accept -> grant-only idempotent two-sided reward. The token discipline (un-forgeable at the signing root, TTL against the token's own iat, fail-closed consume-once) is REUSED from elevated-access-session; attribution/reward/fraud invariants are design-derived. A self-serve growth loop the improvement loop can propose tuning for (reward size/copy) under admin gating. Promoted from candidate; INV-RIL-001..006.

patterns.title: Language-Agnostic Build/Test Floor
patterns.summary: The pre-condition gate everything stands on: one command builds+tests+lints the whole (polyglot) repo, run byte-identically local and in CI, so green-locally predicts green-in-CI. Fail-closed (no silent skip), pre-condition for every merge/deploy, optional zero-cost-until-opt-in (manual-dispatch CI). Realized by the factory on itself (chief-wiggum Makefile == ci.yml). Promoted from candidate; INV-BTF-001..005.

patterns.title: Bidirectional Reconciliation Sweep
patterns.summary: Periodic job repairing local<->external divergence in both directions plus a stale-in-flight sweep. Mined discipline: status-guarded CAS repair, state-machine legality before every write, fail-closed on unknown age, re-confirm against live external truth before destroying, deterministic idempotency keys, paired flag set/clear sweeps, per-run counts with surfaced skips. Promoted from candidate; INV-RSW-001..007.

patterns.title: Transactional Email & Dunning Lifecycle
patterns.summary: Provider-neutral lifecycle messaging: transport-shaped send seam, atomic send-once keys (unique index/CAS, never read-then-write), outbox with provider correlation, re-assert-state-before-send, declared blocking/best-effort criticality. Dunning half (bounded ladder -> explicit grant-preserving degrade) is design-derived and flagged ASPIRATIONAL until a product builds it. Promoted from candidate; INV-TED-001..007.

patterns.title: Feature Entitlements Read-Model
patterns.summary: One resolver answering 'what can this account do', consumed identically by backend gates and frontend: per-key tier<-override<-grandfather layering (reuses entitlement-overlay's mined discipline), fail-closed on unknown principal, explicit dated grandfathering, deployment-capability/entitlement split, tier ceiling enforced at write with audit. Promoted from candidate; INV-FE-001..006.

patterns.title: Self-Serve Billing Portal
patterns.summary: Provider-hosted portal session minted server-side (customer binding from the server's own mirror, caller-scoped, fail-closed) + a webhook-authoritative local plan/seat mirror with a single sanctioned writer, fetch-on-webhook intake (verified, event-id-deduped, persist-after-mutate), and subscription state that actually degrades capability via feature-entitlements. Promoted from candidate; INV-SBP-001..006.

patterns.title: Platform Cost Observability
patterns.summary: Surface the platform's own spend — the whole bill: cloud provider AND per-call vendors (LLM inference, media, email, managed DB, processor fees) — app-scoped and read-only in the SaaS admin panel. Per-source read-only credentials, ingest-then-serve snapshots (never request-path billing calls), staleness/settling-lag honesty, provision-time app attribution with sum-preserving breakdowns and an explicit unattributed bucket, and out-of-band budget alerts. Watches money going OUT the way the billing patterns watch money coming in; actuals feed the stack cost-tier model and /business-consultant unit economics. INV-PCO-001..007 (001 reuses an in-repo cluster; 002 borrows the deployment-release identity-split discipline without claiming realization; the rest design-derived — not yet built in any mined app, chief-wiggum#229).

patterns.title: Landing-Page Smoke Test
patterns.summary: The cheapest universal demand test, stamped as an experiment (chief-wiggum#236): an honest static landing page + signup-capture instrumentation stub, bound to a pre-registered assumption.py test card whose threshold was hashed into the portfolio journal BEFORE launch. Success criterion is a per-cohort visitor-to-signup rate (vanity counters rejected); a signup is strength-2 (click) evidence — it can falsify demand cheaply, never validate willingness to pay. Pre-registration/vanity-lint invariants realized in-repo (scripts/assumption.py); page-level invariants design-derived until first grounded use. INV-LPS-001..005.

patterns.title: Presale (Honest Pre-Order)
patterns.summary: Checkout on an unbuilt product with HONEST pre-order framing (chief-wiggum#236): not-built-yet, price, and delivery window stated before the payment step; a REAL charge or authorized deposit is the datum (a simulated charge demotes the evidence to click class); refund-on-kill counted as wind-down cost in the harvest check. The only experiment class producing strength-5 (money) evidence — what the evidence-strength floor on bet.py transition building requires (Blank: purchase orders, not enthusiasm). Pre-registration/vanity-lint invariants realized in-repo (scripts/assumption.py); page/checkout invariants design-derived until first grounded use. INV-PRE-001..005.

patterns.title: Grounded Sales Chat (public pre-signup assistant)
patterns.summary: Anonymous landing-page LLM assistant answering pre-signup questions from a server-owned, code-grounded prompt whose capability/pricing lists are declared COMPLETE (closure clause: absent means non-existent, denied plainly). Prompt changes are eval-gated (harness parses the shipped source, replays a six-category probe corpus, hash-stamps transcripts); output rendering is allowlist-only; spend is contained by a four-layer stack (env-off -> kill switch -> credits breaker -> two-tier limiter) plus server-enforced caps; transcripts are identity-free, write-only, and retention-bound. Mined from a shipped production SaaS's eval-tuned assistant (19/20); the retention clause is design-derived from the mined gap. INV-GSC-001..009.

stacks.$comment: Concrete stack profiles bind these vendor-neutral patterns to a real infrastructure stack + runnable stand-up skills + a cost model. This is the layer that turns the catalog into a micro/mini-SaaS factory. Index: patterns/stacks/registry.json. See docs/patterns-registry.md#stack-profiles.

profiles.summary: Firebase Hosting + Cloud Run + Firestore/Atlas + Firebase Auth + Stripe + Resend + Secret Manager + keyless WIF, as a T0->T1->T2 cost ladder ($0 PoC -> paid prod).

meta_disciplines.$comment: Recurring cross-pattern engineering rules worth stating once, not registry entries themselves.
rules: fail-closed on unknown/ambiguous input (grace windows, revocation lookups, tenant resolution, unknown-tier fallback)
idempotency + guarded conditional updates for anything touching external state (incl. send-once keys for messaging)
injected interface seams for every gate so services stay testable without real infra
document accepted TOCTOU/limitation classes inline rather than hiding them
external state changes are authoritative via signed webhooks, never the client redirect
